The Person

Behind the Process

I started on the instrumentation side — DCS screens, PLC panels, wiring diagrams — before moving into the business and systems side of manufacturing. Somewhere between an engineering degree, an MBA in Operations, and a lot of time spent on dispatch floors, I found the work I actually like: making the boring parts of a plant run so smoothly nobody has to think about them.

These days that means SAP PM, dispatch and inventory workflows, and the odd GenAI experiment on the side. Below is less a resume and more a running log — the projects, the plants, and a few photos from along the way.

Built & Shipped

Projects

Data-driven process work, plant by plant.

01

One Business Unit, One Inventory

SAP PM/MM · Warehouse Strategy
Nuvoco Vistas, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

A unified warehouse strategy built to stop inventory from quietly piling up across sites. Analyzed stock movement data to cut slow and non-moving inventory by 25%, making one plant's excess visible to another's shortage.

02

Digital Inspection & Dispatch

Power Automate · SQL · Python
Nuvoco Vistas, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

Replaced paper inspection checklists with a mobile QR-based system — took paper consumption to zero and gave maintenance teams a faster, data-backed read on equipment downtime.

03

Automated Bag Counting & Dispatch Digitization

ILMS · Automation · SQL
Nuvoco Vistas, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

Engineered an automated bag-counting system across loading machines, integrated with ILMS so dispatch data captures itself instead of relying on a manual tally — improving data accuracy for downstream reporting.

04

RABH Panel Elimination & DCS Logic Redesign

ABB 800xA v5.1 · DCS Logic · Excel · SQL
Meghalaya Cements, Meghalaya

Studied equipment operating data in Excel and SQL to identify a redundant local RABH control panel adding cost without functional value. Redesigned the DCS logic in ABB 800xA v5.1 to run RABH operation smoothly without it — delivering an estimated ₹17 lakh/year in cost savings.

05

Legacy PLC Platform Upgrade

Rockwell PLC
Nuvoco Vistas, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

Assessed the plant's control processor for obsolescence risk and led the upgrade path from Rockwell PLC-5/80 to 1756-L85E, reducing dependency on unsupported hardware and improving system reliability.

06

Packing Line Optimization

SPC · Process Data Analysis
Birla Corporation, Maihar, MP & Nuvoco Vistas, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

Optimized bag filter RPM and brought packing plant output under statistical process control across two plants, improving consistency and reducing unnecessary energy draw.

07

Multi-Site Loading Diagnostics — India & Nepal

Time-Motion Study · Data Analysis
Multiple plants, India & Nepal

Led troubleshooting and software upgrades on packing and loading machines across plants in India and Nepal. Ran time-motion studies against operational data to recommend a more economical loading approach.

08

OHE Line Extension for One-Shot Rake Placement

SQL · Excel · Electrical & Instrumentation · Automation
MP Birla Cement

Ran a time-motion study on wagon loading siding operations and identified that a 200m OHE (overhead electrification) line extension would enable one-shot rake placement. Commissioned the extension, saving an estimated 1 hour of demurrage time per rake.

★

Process Reliability & TPM

Preventive Maintenance · Root-Cause Analysis · SAP PM

Strengthened preventive maintenance systems to improve equipment reliability, reduced downtime through root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving, and enhanced maintenance planning effectiveness through SAP PM integration.
